actual_scope: Supplement the selected PR1094 ancestry with an opt-in PR589 supplier identity guard, checking four committed assemblies and an optional newly emitted assembly/result against the exact source Git objects and COPY/profile deficit.
scope_change_reason: The card is narrowed to the unbound bit_supplier identity named as an open next question in PR1277. This is a complementary executable guard, not a new discovery of the ancestry finding, a change to a frozen verifier, or a mathematical supplier improvement.
bottleneck_link: A correct priced number does not establish the identity of its cited supplier. Binding that identity and the COPY-derived deficit makes source-bound review reusable; it does not improve the complex bottleneck or kappa.
stop_rule: Complete exact source/merge/retained byte bindings, nine COPY ranks and four assembly checks, then semantic and relocation/CLI controls. No optimizer, moment re-certification or supplier cold replay.
